result_text:
The "past 90d" block now shows the LOC of repositories with commits in the past 90 days, not the 180-day figure.

The bug was in `addBigRepositoriesSummary` in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/LandscapeReportGenerator.java` (around line 906). The block passed `loc180Days` as its LOC value while its percentage already used `loc90Days`. I changed that one reference to `loc90Days`, so the LOC and percentage now both come from the 90-day figure.

The `reports` module compiles offline (`mvn -q -o -pl reports compile`). I did not run the tests, and I did not check the rendered report against your example (500 vs 2.5K LOC). Nothing is committed.
